blurb: Built in Italy by two of the premier tent building firms in the world, The Big Top has been a staple in Grand Center Arts District for two years. Under the Kranzberg Arts Foundation, The Big Top has found a permanent home allowing significant improvements to the venue’s production and guest experience.
